branch_family_rows.label: Mainline
branch_family_rows.summary: Mainline is split between shared integration on `dev` and the admissible baseline on `main` so the repo can stay two-branch by default while still distinguishing release posture.

source_refs.rationale: Promotion copies exact tested digests forward and must not improvise release truth from mutable branches.
Candidate identity must remain the durable release anchor even when human-friendly labels or branch names differ.

branch_family_rows.label: Release Preparation
branch_family_rows.summary: Release preparation branches stabilize one planned version train, rehearse canaries, and preserve rollback-safe posture while they still track the same reader-window law as the baseline.

source_refs.rationale: Release preparation exists to preserve expand -> migrate/backfill -> verify -> contract chronology before destructive promotion.

branch_family_rows.label: Hotfix
branch_family_rows.summary: Hotfix branches patch a pinned or currently admissible baseline and may enter emergency promotion only with explicit override lineage.

source_refs.rationale: Emergency changes must still preserve typed rollback versus fail-forward posture.

branch_family_rows.label: Experimental
branch_family_rows.summary: Experimental work can build preview candidates but never becomes production evidence directly.

source_refs.rationale: Non-admissible exploratory work must not inherit production release semantics through branch naming alone.

branch_pattern_rows.label: Integration mainline
notes: This keeps the day-to-day shared branch separate from the protected admissible baseline.
Direct production promotion from `dev` is forbidden.

branch_pattern_rows.label: Protected baseline
notes: The baseline branch is where admitted candidates are anchored after review.
Pinned-baseline re-promotions are expressed from the baseline family, not by special tags alone.

branch_pattern_rows.label: Versioned release preparation branch
notes: Release preparation branches are expected when a version train needs stabilization without freezing all integration work on `dev`.

branch_pattern_rows.label: Versioned hotfix branch
notes: Hotfix branches must carry baseline lineage so emergency promotion cannot hide which release train is being patched.

branch_pattern_rows.label: Experimental branch
notes: Experimental work may publish preview artifacts but must merge back through governed branches before admissible release.

branch_role_notes.summary: Shared branch for routine integration and preview rehearsal.
Protected branch for current admissible baseline and pinned-baseline re-promotions.
Version-specific hardening branch for release rehearsals.
Patch branch cut from a known baseline or pinned release.

notes: The repo can remain two-branch by default (`main` and `dev`) while still allowing explicit release or hotfix branches when the release train needs isolation.
Branch names are never the source of release truth; they only govern admissibility and version-lane derivation.
